newsitem.title: USA: British Air unveils 3-year, $10 billion makeover.
newsitem.headline: British Air unveils 3-year, $10 billion makeover.

text.p: British Airways Plc on Tuesday unveiled a three-year, $10 billion makeover that involves a new corporate identity and new services, products, aircraft, facilities and expanded employee training.

The airline, at a news conference in New York, said it will add 43 new aircraft to its fleet over the period: 29 Boeing 747-400s, nine 777s and five 757s. It also intends to spend hundreds of millions of dollars developing new routes, new services and products, and a new approach to customer service.
